summary: 周六整体安静，但后量子交易成本有了第一批实测数据：批量证明草案获分配编号 EIP-8500，作者 Marchhill 用实测建议把 leanSPHINCS 验证 gas 从 15,400 降到 3,000、leanSTARK 从 572,000 降到 30,000（均为临时值）。EIP-8151 的公共 mempool 规则获评审认可；ERC-8499 讨论转向助记词指纹设计。11-16 晚 ACDT #103 将公布 EIP-8037/8038 重新定价审计结论。

items.note: 2026-11-15 02:59 colinlyguo 留言建议补充理由：对“其他摘要”这一类，风险不只是签名重用；已知公钥时，若摘要由攻击者选择，可以构造一组 (digest, v, r, s) 恢复出目标地址而无需私钥。03:08 给出评审结论“lgtm，只补充理由”。PR 尚未合并。
items.title_en: EIP-8151 public mempool rules PR approved by a reviewer
items.note_en: At 02:59 on 2026-11-15, colinlyguo suggested strengthening the rationale: for the "any other digest" case the risk isn't just signature reuse. Given a known public key and an attacker-chosen digest, an attacker can build a (digest, v, r, s) tuple that recovers the target address without the private key. At 03:08 the review concluded "lgtm, only a rationale supplement". The PR isn't merged yet.

items.title: Magicians：如何验证已部署合约仍在运行审计过的代码
items.note: 2026-11-14 22:17 thomasharris 指出 eth_getProof 可以证明某个 EIP-7702 账户在特定区块的 codeHash（即 0xef0100||address），但重新委托没有事件。2026-11-15 01:01 Zealynx 补充：同一区块内可以先换走再换回，按区块扫 codeHash 会漏掉；比较时段两端的 nonce 更可靠，因为每次生效的授权都会让 nonce 加一。
items.title_en: Magicians: checking that a deployed contract still runs the audited commit
items.note_en: At 22:17 on 2026-11-14, thomasharris noted that eth_getProof can prove an EIP-7702 account's codeHash (that is, 0xef0100||address) at a given block, but redelegation emits no event. At 01:01 on 2026-11-15, Zealynx added that an account can switch away and back within one block, so scanning codeHash per block can miss it. Comparing the nonce at both ends of the period is more reliable, since every applied authorization bumps the nonce by one.

items.title: ERC-8499 讨论：助记词指纹和有状态密钥
items.note: 2026-11-14 16:16 SergeevDmitry 确认作者已在恢复章节加入“旧密钥类型也要派生”；2026-11-15 01:04 Zealynx 建议固定指纹格式，并从公钥（例如账户 0 的 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s 公钥）计算，类似 BIP-32 从主公钥取指纹；若直接从种子计算，拿到写有指纹的纸的人可以按 PBKDF2 速度离线猜 passphrase。对有状态密钥，他支持随机选叶子，因为设备复位或闪存回滚会让计数器重复。
items.title_en: ERC-8499 discussion: mnemonic fingerprints and stateful keys
items.note_en: At 16:16 on 2026-11-14, SergeevDmitry confirmed the author had added "keep deriving old key types" to the restore section. At 01:04 on 2026-11-15, Zealynx suggested fixing the fingerprint format and computing it from a public key (for example account 0's SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s key), the way BIP-32 takes its fingerprint from the master public key. If it's computed straight from the seed, anyone holding the paper with the fingerprint can test passphrase guesses offline at PBKDF2 speed. For stateful keys he backs picking leaves at random, because a device reset or a rolled-back flash makes a counter repeat.

summary_en: A quiet Saturday overall, but post-quantum transaction costs got their first real measurements. The proof batching draft was assigned EIP-8500, and its author Marchhill used benchmarks to argue for cutting leanSPHINCS verification gas from 15,400 to 3,000 and leanSTARK from 572,000 to 30,000 (all provisional). EIP-8151's public mempool rules got a reviewer's approval, and ERC-8499 discussion moved on to mnemonic fingerprint design. The EIP-8037/8038 repricing audit findings land at ACDT #103 on the evening of 11-16.
